members.name: id
members.doc: Stable id, used as the key.

members.name: detail
members.doc: A line shown under the label while the step runs, such as the file being read.

types.name: TodoListProps
types.doc: The plan an agent is working through. Each step moves from pending to running (a spinner and a shimmer on its label) to done (the check draws itself and the label is struck through), while the header counts progress. The header folds the list away and then shows the step in progress.

members.name: items
members.doc: The steps, in order. Change an item's `status` to move it along.

members.name: showProgress
members.doc: Shows the "2 of 5" count and the progress bar.

members.name: open
members.doc: Controlled open state of the list.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the list starts open when uncontrolled.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the header is pressed.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
